enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Fan is on. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Push blanket down. Turn head. Sleep. Stir. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Turn off fan. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a leisurely public-holiday breakfast of toast and tea using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Open bread bag. Take out two slices. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out butter. Take out jam. Close fridge. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Put on plate. Spread butter. Spread jam. Pour tea. Sit down. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish eating. Wash plate. Wash knife. Wash mug. Put away. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a morning walk around the neighbourhood to get fresh air and light exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open front door. Step outside. Close door. Walk down driveway. Turn left. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk around block. Pass park. Turn right. Walk up hill. Reach intersection. Turn around. Walk back. Cross street. Walk up driveway. Open front door. Step inside. Close door. Remove shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying business course readings on the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open browser. Navigate to course website. Open PDF reading. Scroll down. Read. Highlight text. Type notes. Open new tab. Search for term. Read. Take phone. Check message. Put phone down. Continue reading. Type summary. Save document. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry, loading the washing machine and sorting clothes for the coming study week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry basket. Pick up clothes. Sort into piles. Open washing machine door. Load whites. Add detergent. Close door. Set cycle. Press start. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Fold shirts. Fold pants. Stack clothes. Walk to bathroom. Check washing machine. Wait for cycle. Remove clothes. Hang clothes. Close washing machine door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a simple lunch of leftovers reheated in the microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out leftovers. Open microwave. Place container. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open door. Take out container. Close door. Sit at table. Eat. Finish. Wash container. Put away. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a written business assignment draft on the computer while checking notes on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Type heading. Open notes on phone. Unlock phone. Scroll notes. Put phone down. Type paragraph. Pick up phone. Check reference. Put phone down. Continue typing. Save document. Open browser. Search for source. Copy citation. Paste into document. Format text. Save. Close document. Shut down laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and cooling down with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Press power button. Set temperature. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Flip channels. Stop on show. Watch. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Watch. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up controller. Turn on game console. Press power button. Wait for load. Select game. Press start. Play. Move controller. Press buttons. Pause game. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Resume game. Play. Save game. Exit game. Turn off console. Put down controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Going out to buy groceries and household supplies at the local supermarket
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up wallet. Pick up reusable bags. Open front door. Step outside. Close door. Walk to supermarket. Enter supermarket. Pick up basket. Walk aisles. Select items. Place in basket. Continue. Go to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Walk home. Enter house. Put away groceries.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker while using the range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Cover. Wait. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Serve onto plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and putting leftovers in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Scrape leftovers into container. Open fridge. Place container. Close fridge. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Wash plate. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, wiping the counters and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash dishes. Rinse. Place in rack. Wash pots. Rinse. Place in rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counters. Wipe stove. Wipe table. Hang cloth. Put away dishes. Empty trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing retail work rosters and online study materials on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open email. Check roster. Open calendar. Add shifts. Open study portal. Download materials. Read. Take notes. Open new tab. Research. Save files. Close laptop. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a show on TV and browsing social media on the phone to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Flip to show. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check notifications. Put phone down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night-time grooming
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Shampoo. Rinse. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone and setting an alarm before bed with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open reading app. Read. Set alarm. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep.
